environment.description: Same Flask application container deployed on ECS Fargate. Traffic ingress is exclusively through an AWS Lambda Function URL configured as the integration target. The Lambda function URL resource policy specifies AuthType: AWS_IAM with a FunctionUrlAuthType of AWS_IAM on the function itself (not NONE). The Lambda acts as a reverse proxy, forwarding authenticated requests to the Fargate service via AWS Cloud Map service discovery on a private VPC subnet. The Fargate task security group ingress rule only allows TCP 8080 from the Lambda's ENI security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b). No public ALB or internet gateway route exists for the Fargate subnet. The Lambda function URL's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal 'arn:aws:iam::account:root' with condition 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' matching the organization. DNS record payments.example.com points to the Lambda Function URL's CloudFront distribution (auto-provisioned by Lambda Function URL service).

config.runtime: ECS Fargate + Lambda Function URL proxy
config.networking: Fargate in private subnet, no IGW, SG allows only Lambda ENI
config.service_discovery: AWS Cloud Map private DNS namespace
config.public_endpoint: Lambda Function URL (requires SigV4 signed requests)
config.cookie_handling: Lambda proxy strips and re-signs cookies for internal forwarding
